scope: Prepare exact preserved agent-patch behavioral tests using the existing OS supervisor, without execution, new permissions or product adoption; align descriptive timeout metadata across all fixed builders.
riskAnalysis: Prepare-only sealed job and exact source/patch hashes. No provider, grant, dispatch or qualification API; existing dispatcher rejects it. Guest code is serialized, never locally evaluated. Closed supervisor transformations preserve isolation; failed product outcomes cannot create qualification or acceptance.

threatModel.assets: Exact model patch provenance, source hashes, OS isolation controls, owner/workspace/release binding, sanitized outcomes, original review history and spending authority.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Untrusted patched source remains data on host; existing OS jail is the future execution boundary. Parsed or mocked outcomes do not establish a live run, permission or acceptance.
threatModel.abuseCases: Substitute source or commands, forge job/result/workspace, bypass qualification, alter trusted supervisor, leak output, hide failed cleanup or adopt a failed patch.
threatModel.mitigations: Exact baseline/patched and proposal/descriptor pins, closed input keys, WeakMap preparation provenance, command/result hashes and ordered checks, exact supervisor parity, limited output and fail-closed cleanup; no activation surface.

defects.rootCause: Current call-row task has no qualified source-test profile; existing Starter permission cannot safely execute another task. This is an intentional boundary, not evidence of a broken sandbox.
defects.detectionGap: Fixture patch application and model critique do not establish source behavior or isolate generated execution.
defects.regression: Seven fixed guest cases prepared, exact source/patch identity and authority denial checks; fakeOS supervisor runs never evaluate guest source. Invalid timestamp handling remains an unproven adoption gate.
defects.historicalPrevention: Require exact task/profile qualification and preserved actual test results; do not borrow consumed Starter grants or relabel fixtures.

defects.rootCause: All fixed builders described a fifteen-second timeout while their existing supervisor enforces twenty seconds.
defects.detectionGap: Metadata was not crosschecked against the actual common supervised test call.
defects.regression: All three descriptors now state the unchanged twenty-second timeout; old command hashes and exact derived isolation parity remain checked.
defects.historicalPrevention: Keep descriptive resource metadata aligned with existing enforced behavior without silently changing bounds or historical evidence.

rollback: Keep profile unqualified/disconnected and paid execution disabled. Revert new preparation files through reviewed feature changes; preserve original model evidence, failed test logs and historical commands. No resources exist to delete.

proactiveReview.architecture: Reuse existing serialized trusted supervisor and jail; no competing executor, provider, journal or orchestration.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No new package, image, account or credential. New files are included in existing source fingerprint tracing.
proactiveReview.threats: Untrusted source, forged qualification, altered supervisor, cross-workspace results and cleanup failure cannot create execution or acceptance authority.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Closed source identity, malformed result, fake checks, descendant proof missing, output overflow, failed cleanup and failed behavior covered without exposing raw content.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Real trusted supervisor under fakeOS/process only; guest/source never evaluated. Exact normalized source parity preserves every isolation instruction.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Work QA found timeout metadata mismatch; corrected across all three builders. QA and Auditor approve preparation only, not live qualification.
proactiveReview.recovery: No VM/model call or provider mutation occurred. Future finite VM must have reviewed exact identities, separate spending authority, durable create intent and verified shutdown.
proactiveReview.readiness: 53 focused checks and independent15-check review passed. Exact committed/hosted source verification and separately authorized live VM remain required; no fixture is called live execution.
